domain_hint: Structural FEA of a lunar hopper avionics bracket under vibration, thermal bias, and bolt preload
ambiguity_notes:
- Mesh independence claims conflict with later note showing 6.7% change at the hotspot when stabilization is reduced.
- Material property source inconsistent: two include decks (MMPDS vs vendor 55 C) referenced across runs.
- Physics settings contradictory: dynamic step reported with geometric nonlinearity, but a cited run has NLGEOM turned off.
- Load definition/preload unclear: bullets cite nominal torque-based 9 kN yet mention measured clamp loads not used.
- Test correlation mixed: slide claims within 5% while first mode shows 17% deviation before mass tuning.
- Uncertainty sampling: deck says 50-point LHS, archive shows only 12 samples completed.
- Configuration management: Git tag cited, but last-minute local changes and missing PSD file hashes noted.
- Review independence: peer review planned, but sign-off performed by model owner due to reviewer unavailability.
